description: Configure the security settings in JFrog Artifactory to enforce a user lockout policy. Specifically, enable user locking to protect against brute-force attacks. Set the policy to lock users after 3 failed login attempts, with a temporary lockout period of 1 hour. You will need to navigate to the Administration module, locate the Security configuration settings, and apply these changes. The Artifactory URL is http://localhost:8082 and the admin credentials are 'admin' / 'password'.
